historical_definition_clarification.before: Historical-input and runtime limitations preclude a universal bitwise reproduction claim. Exact historical PIXEL_LAND identity was not attained; approved practical scientific-equivalence results and stricter diagnostics are retained. FEMW18CHILD is excluded as a duplicate; no substitute is introduced.
historical_definition_clarification.after: A historical FEMW18CHILD output was excluded from the 2026 canonical release because its produced raster values duplicated WOMCHILD. This finding concerns the produced data layer; it does not establish that the two variable names originally represented the same demographic concept. WOMCHILD in the released dataset denotes females ages 15–49, using SUM(P12_030N:P12_039N), and is not a count of mothers. The intended historical FEMW18CHILD source definition has not been verified.
